name: 94403 · San Mateo, CA
findings: ZIP 94403 (San Mateo) has 156 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94403 (San Mateo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.
